text: We can't choose where we come from, but we can choose where we go from there.
translation: 我们不能选择从哪里来，却能选择往哪里去。
author: katshi94

text: Do you know where I can get a computer for a good price?
translation: 你知道哪里买电脑性价比高吗？
author: atitarev

text: Other people can think what they want, as long as they think like I do.
translation: 别人可以随便怎么想，只要他们的想法与我的相同。
author: paper1n0

text: I think that I now have enough money to buy the car that I want.
translation: 我认为我现在有足够的钱买我想要的那辆车。
author: CK

text: I really wish I could go to bed early every day and get up early!
translation: 我非常希望每天都能早睡早起！
author: sundown

text: If you enjoy the work you do, you have something worth more than money.
translation: 如果你喜欢你做的工作，你就有比金钱更有价值的东西。
author: CK

text: If you could go back and start your life again, from what age would you like to start?
translation: 假如能回到过去让人生再来一遍的话，你希望能回到几岁的时候？
author: CK

text: You speak French very well. I wish I could speak it as well as you.
translation: 你的法语讲的很好。我希望可以讲的像你一样好。
author: CK

text: What would you attempt to do if you knew you could not fail?
translation: 如果你有一次绝对不会失败的机会，你会选择做什么事情呢？
author: darinmex

text: Because we only have one earth, we need to understand more how to care for it.
translation: 我们因为只有一个地球，所以更要懂得爱护它。
author: Kiwi

text: I need you to promise that you'll do what I ask you to do.
translation: 我需要你承诺你会照我说的话去做。
author: CK

text: Sometimes, I wish I could walk through time, and meet myself back when I was still a child.
translation: 有时候，真希望自己可以适时的穿越回去，去见见那个还是个小孩子的自己。
author: LeeSooHa

text: Only if you study hard will you be able to get into university.
translation: 只有你好好学习才可以考得上大学。
author: sundown

text: Whether you like it or not, we have to do it that way.
translation: 不管你想不想，我们必要那样做。
author: CM

text: If you want to change the world, then you should start with yourself.
translation: 如果你想改变世界，就从你自己开始吧。
author: sharris123

text: If you pass the exam, how about we go to the bar to drink beer?
translation: 你如果通过考试，我们一起去酒吧喝啤酒，好不好？
author: n1ls

text: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
translation: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
author: CK

text: No matter how important the question may or may not be, you must solve it.
translation: 不管这个问题重不重要，你必须解决它。
author: soj4l

text: It will not be long before we can know the truth of the matter.
translation: 我们很快就可以知道事情的真相了。
author: AlanF_US

text: It will not be long before we can take a trip to the moon.
translation: 我们不久就能到月球旅行了。
author: CM

text: If you have no character to lose, people will have no faith in you.
translation: 如果你没有尝试过失败的角色，那么人们也就不会相信你。
author: fenfang557

text: I want to go to the hospital to get a complete check-up.
translation: 我想去医院做一个全面的检查。
author: bekindtoall

text: I would rather stay at home than go out in this hot weather.
translation: 在这种暑天里我宁愿呆在家也不出去。
author: CK

text: To tell the truth, I would rather stay at home than go out.
translation: 老实说，我其实想留在家中，不想出外的。
author: Dejo

text: No matter where you go, the sky will always be the same color.
translation: 不管你去哪里，天空都是同样的颜色。
author: JSakuragi

text: The time will soon come when man will be able to travel to the moon.
translation: 在不久的将来人类会可以去月球旅游。
author: CN

text: It doesn't matter whether you have money or not. I love you just the same.
translation: 不论你有没有钱，我都爱你。
author: paper1n0

text: If you go by bus, you can get there in about one-third of the time.
translation: 你乘公交车去的话，可以省掉三分之二的时间。
author: CK

text: No matter how hard I try, I will never be able to catch up with him.
translation: 我无论怎么努力，都永远无法追上他。
author: CK

text: If you can read this, it means that you can speak one language!
translation: 如果你能将它读出来，那就意味着你会说这门语言。
author: Ricardo14

text: You speak so loudly I can even hear you on the first floor.
translation: 你讲话大声到我在一楼都听得到。
author: leishenki

text: If I tell you not to run around, would you have any comments?
translation: 假如我告诉你，大家不要走来走去，你有意见吗？
author: FishlandicFishy

text: You can add sentences that you do not know how to translate. Perhaps someone else will know.
translation: 你可以添加你不知道怎么翻译的句子，或许别人会知道。
author: mahdigol

text: You ought to go by taxi, or you might not get there in time.
translation: 你最好乘出租车去，不然可能会赶不及。
author: timmartin

text: It will make little difference whether you go there by taxi or on foot.
translation: 你乘出租车去和走路去也没有什么分别。
author: CK

text: Take this as friendly advice: I think you should do sport more often to keep yourself fit.
translation: 把它当成友好的建议，但我认为你应该多运动来保持你自己的体型和健康。
author: LoverofEnglish

text: I want to move out of this cramped room as soon as I can.
translation: 我想尽快从这个不透气的屋子里出去。
author: CK

text: Only if you put up a different sign can you become a miscellany store.
translation: 只要换上不同招牌，就能成为各种商店。
author: peterius

text: If you would agree to answer some of the questions below, I would be extremely grateful.
translation: 如果您同意回答下面几个问题，我就非常感激您的帮助。
author: eastasiastudent

text: How do I feel about what I'm doing to get what I want out of life?
translation: 我对于自己为实现人生目标所做的事有何感受？
author: shekitten

text: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
translation: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。
author: CK

text: Money takes a long time to earn, but you can spend it in no time.
translation: 钱要花很长的时间来赚，但你可以一下子就花掉它了。
author: CM

text: In the long run, we can save a lot of money by buying this machine.
translation: 长远来说，我们买了这台机器可以省回很多钱。
author: CK

text: Sometimes I walk to work, and sometimes I ride my bike, because I live very close to work.
translation: 我有时候走路去上班，有时候骑自行车去上班，因为我家离单位很近。
author: Mouseneb

text: In conclusion, the next step is to decide what we should do for the next step.
translation: 总之，下一步是要决定我们下一步应该做什么。
author: vicch

text: I suppose it's different when you think about it over the long term.
translation: 我认为你考虑久了就会不一样了。
author: wakaran

text: Do you think you can live on a dollar a day in America?
translation: 你觉得你在美国每天只用一美元能生活吗？
author: CN

text: Next time you come to see me, I will show you the book.
translation: 下次你来看我的时候，我会给你看那本书。
author: CK

text: If I had the money, I would often go out and have fun.
translation: 要是我有钱的话，我将常常出去玩儿。
author: CM

text: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
translation: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
author: Source_Benedict_1921

text: For example, if I want to get downtown what bus should I take?
translation: 比如，我要去市中心，可以乘坐什么交通工具？
author: weihaiping

text: You should do that as often as you can while you're still young.
translation: 趁你还年轻的时候，你应该尽可能经常地这样做。
author: CK

text: No matter how many times I read this book I discover something new.
translation: 这本书不管读多少次，我都能从中有新发现。
author: atitarev

text: To be very honest with you, I don't think I can do that.
translation: 和你说句实话，我觉得我做不到。
author: CK

text: Sir, I would like to deposit my money. How do I do that?
translation: 先生，我要存钱，怎么存？
author: xiuqin

text: She and I hold the same position in the company, but she earns more than I do.
translation: 我和她在公司里职位相同，但她赚的钱比我多。
author: Mouseneb

text: I do really want to watch this match, but I'm not sure if I have the time.
translation: 我倒是很想去看这场比赛，可是不知道有没有时间。
author: serendipity42

text: It'd be great if you could pick up some bread before you come home.
translation: 这将会是巨大的，如果你可以挑选一些面包，然后再回家。
author: mcq

text: You should be more careful with respect to how you talk to those people.
translation: 关于用什么方式和那些人说话，你要谨慎一些。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: If you would like to speak to a customer service representative, please press three.
translation: 如果想与客服代表通话，请按三。
author: CK

text: It is up to you to decide whether we will go there or not.
translation: 该由你来决定我们去不去那儿。
author: Zifre

text: I didn't get to spend a lot of time with you on this visit.
translation: 你这次来，我都没跟你在一起待多久。
author: fenfang557

text: You could go to rest on the sea while I'm on a business trip.
translation: 在我出差时你可以去享受沙滩。
author: carlosalberto

text: How can you accuse me of such a thing? I would never lay a hand on my child.
translation: 你怎么敢指责我做这种事？我决不会动手打我的儿子。
author: darinmex

text: You can come pick up the goods, or we can bring them to you.
translation: 你可以来提货，我们也可以把商品送到您那里。
author: plumblossoms

text: When I hear the news, I get goose bumps. How could there be such a dangerous thing?
translation: 听到这条新闻我直起鸡皮疙瘩，怎么会有这样危险的事啊？
author: LeeSooHa

text: Be careful not to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.
translation: 小心不要在单行道逆向行驶。
author: Source_VOA

text: No matter how hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.
translation: 无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。
author: CK

text: I have so many things to tell you that I don't know where to start.
translation: 我有太多话想和你说，以至于不知从何说起。
author: Eldad

text: If one day you realised that you are good for nothing, what will you do?
translation: 如果某天你发现你一无所长你会怎么办？
author: thunderbreak

text: If I were you, I would have done the same thing in such a difficult situation.
translation: 如果我是你，我会在这种困难的情况下做同样的事。
author: Snout

text: I feel restless when I have to wait too long for my friend to show up.
translation: 等朋友等太久时，会感到烦躁.
author: CM

text: No matter what you do you must always do it to the best of your ability.
translation: 不管你做什么都要尽全力。
author: Chrikaru

text: Every day I either ride a bike or get the bus to work.
translation: 我每天要么骑自行车，要么坐公交车上班。
author: CM

text: I depend on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.
translation: 每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。
author: trieuho

text: Whether rain or shine, I go to the park every day to run.
translation: 不管下不下雨，我都每天去公园跑步。
author: SecondInstance

text: Put down your name on the list and pass it on to the next person.
translation: 把你的名字写在名单上，然后把名单传给下一个人。
author: Zifre

text: I'm not sure who I should give this present to, the girl or the boy?
translation: 我不知道这份礼物应该给谁：给女孩子呢，还是给男孩子？
author: Dorenda

text: I wonder if a day will come when money will be something found only in museums.
translation: 我想知道是不是会有一天钱会变成只有在博物馆才能找到的东西。
author: darinmex

text: If I do not get the item this week, I will make a complaint to PayPal.
translation: 如果本周我收不到货，我就向paypal投诉。
author: wangzi0921

text: No matter how cold the weather is, I go to the park every day to run.
translation: 不管天气多么冷，我每天都去公园跑步。
author: SecondInstance

text: Welcome. Now that many people have arrived, please take a seat and wait for a while.
translation: 欢迎光临，现在人很多，请坐下来等一等。
author: sharris123

text: However hard you try, you can't finish it in a week or so.
translation: 你就算多努力，也不可能在一两个星期内做完。
author: CM

text: My mother will attend to the baby while I go to the dance.
translation: 我去参加舞会，母亲就帮忙照顾婴儿。
author: CM

text: The more people you know, the less time you have to see them.
translation: 认识的人愈多，见面的时间就愈少。
author: CK

text: I would like to take a walk, but the day is too hot.
translation: 我本来很想走走，但是天太热了。
author: Brian255

text: Can you produce any evidence that he was not at home that night?
translation: 你能不能提供他那天晚上没在家的证明？
author: CM

text: Even if she doesn't like you, you still have to finish the work.
translation: 即便她不喜欢你，你也要完成工作。
author: konkorde

text: You do not need to tell me if you do not want to.
translation: 如果你不想的话你不必告诉我。
author: BobbyLee

text: Make sure you read this if you want to learn the Kadazan language.
translation: 如果您想学习卡达山语，请务必阅读此内容。
author: LeeSooHa

text: I really hope they can live happily ever after as husband and wife.
translation: 真的希望他们做夫妻白头偕劳。
author: pan176

text: I may have seen that film before, but I can hardly remember it.
translation: 我以前可能看过这部电影，但是我却不怎么记得了。
author: shanghainese

text: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
translation: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
author: CK

text: If you could be a bit more careful, that would be even better.
translation: 如果你能当心些那就更好了。
author: Aphima

text: If I wanted to scare you, I would tell you what I dreamt about a few weeks ago.
translation: 如果我是想吓你，我就会告诉你我几周前梦到的事。
author: AlanF_US

text: The mind should be a good servant, but the heart should be the master.
translation: 心灵应该当一个好仆人，但心应该是主人。
author: Swift

text: If I were to tell you all I know, you would be amazed.
translation: 要是我告诉你我所知的一切，你会被惊呆的。
author: Eldad

text: What really matters more is what I think, not really what you think!
translation: 重要的是我怎么想，而不是你！
author: nonong

text: Turning to the right, you will find the city hall in front of you.
translation: 向右转，你就可以看到市政厅位于正前方。
author: al_ex_an_der

text: I will never sell my friend down the river for anything in the world.
translation: 无论发生什么事，我也绝对不会出卖我的朋友。
author: Dejo

text: You have only to read this article to see how serious the accident was.
translation: 你只要读读这篇文章，就能知道那意外有多严重。
author: CM

text: What do you call a man who takes care of sheep in the field?
translation: 在草原上照顾羊群的人叫什么？
author: CK

text: If you want to lose weight, you should cut down on between-meal snacks.
translation: 你如果想减肥，就应该减少两餐之间的零食。
author: CK

text: I'm a make-up artist. I can turn any girl into a beautiful woman.
translation: 我是个化妆师，每当我把一个姑娘变成大美女。
author: rahim

text: This book will give you a clear idea of the American way of life.
translation: 这书会教给你一个明了的美式人生观。
author: CK

text: I plan to watch a game at the baseball field the day after tomorrow.
translation: 我后天打算去棒球场看一场棒球比赛。
author: Brianna

text: You'll have to get a move on if you want to catch the train.
translation: 要想赶上火车就动作快点。
author: lukaszpp

text: I should probably tell Mary that she should do that as soon as possible.
translation: 我可能要告诉玛丽她应该尽快去做那件事情。
author: CF

text: I bet I can sit here longer without saying a thing than you can.
translation: 我猜我能老实地坐在这更久，不发一句牢骚，而不像你。
author: CK

text: I would rather that you never returned than know that you wanted to leave.
translation: 与其知道你要走，我宁肯你没有回来过。
author: BobbyLee

text: Ah, now I remember – I left it on the table where I filled in the application form.
translation: 哦，想起来了，忘记在填报名单的桌子上。
author: sundown

text: If you want to become thin, you should cut back on the between-meal snacks.
translation: 如果你想变瘦，就应该少点在正餐以外吃零食。
author: CK

text: When you walk around your house, what kind of scenery and buildings can you see?
translation: 当你在房子周围走动时，你能看到什么样的风景和建筑物？
author: sugoisensei

text: I'm sorry to trouble you, but could you tell me the way to the station?
translation: 不好意思，我想请问去车站怎么走？
author: CK

text: Those without knowledge can do nothing, and those who can do nothing can eat nothing.
translation: 没知识的无事干，没事干的无饭吃。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: I hope I will have a chance to see you next time I'm in New York.
translation: 希望下次我在纽约还可以有机会见到你。
author: CK

text: When many enemies appear in front of you, look back, you have many allies as well.
translation: 在前面有很多敌人的时候，还是回头看一眼。朋友的话也是很多的。
author: Ivanovb

text: Thank you for helping me. Please turn off the light, I want to go to sleep.
translation: 我谢谢你帮帮忙，给我把灯关了，我想睡觉了。
author: sharris123

text: If I can finish up this bit of work, I will go to Nanjing on Monday.
translation: 如果我这点活儿可以做完，我将在星期一去南京。
author: luxdelumine

text: If you want to know what beauty is, go out into the wild; there you will find beauty.
translation: 如果你想知道什么是美，请出门，走进自然，在那里你会发现美。
author: pullnosemans

text: You could at least try to be a bit more polite, even though it's not like you.
translation: 无论你平时怎么大大咧咧的，起码试着稍微礼貌一点吧。
author: fcbond

text: I am already very tired, but I still have a lot of work I need to do.
translation: 我已经很困了，但是我还有很多事情要做。
author: sharris123

text: Do you like to send it by air mail or by surface mail?
translation: 您寄航空还是海运？
author: han

text: The style is nice, but do you have it in a different color?
translation: 款式很不错，不过有没有别的颜色？
author: CM

text: We will endeavour to finish the job by the end of the week.
translation: 我们会尽力在这礼拜结束前把工作完成。
author: pigeonenglish

text: I sometimes just don't want to get out of bed in the morning.
translation: 我有时早上不想下床。
author: CK

text: If he could lie about that, he is likely to lie about anything.
translation: 如果他在那件事上说谎，他就可能在任何事上都说谎。
author: Hybrid

text: How many times a day do you look at yourself in the mirror?
translation: 你一天照几次镜子？
author: Zifre

text: Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?
translation: 你知道从火车站到市政府有多远？
author: CK

text: I want to live in a quiet city where the air is clean.
translation: 我想在一个宁静、没有空气污染的城镇里生活。
author: CK

text: I do this job not for the money, but rather for my happiness.
translation: 我做这份工作不是为钱而是为自己开心。
author: LeeSooHa

text: Go straight down the road, and when you pass the traffic light you're there.
translation: 你一路往前走，过了红绿灯就到了。
author: kebukebu

text: If you go to that supermarket, you can buy most things you use in your daily life.
translation: 你去那个超级市场，几乎什么日用品都买得到。
author: CM

text: I can still remember the time when we went on a picnic together.
translation: 我还记得我和你一起去野餐的时候。
author: CK

text: Thank you for all your contributions. We expect to see you again soon.
translation: 谢谢您的贡献。预计我们很快又会见面。
author: Eldad

text: I would have liked to come with you, but I didn't have time.
translation: 我想和你一起去，但是我没有时间。
author: CK

text: When do you get up on Sundays? When do you got to sleep?
translation: 你星期天几点起床？几点睡觉？
author: kayano

text: I ran as fast as I could, but I missed the last train.
translation: 我拼命地跑，但还是错过了末班车。
author: tieguy

text: There can only be one world champion. The question is: Who will it be?
translation: 只有一个人能成为世界冠军。问题是：会是谁呢？
author: sharris123

text: It's really hard to find a job during the summer break as a student.
translation: 学生放暑假时找工作真的很难。
author: frpzzd

text: How do you know they're not just giving you a weird look because you have a funny face?
translation: 你怎么知道他们奇怪的看著你不只是因为你有一张有趣的脸呢？
author: kebukebu

text: You can come to my party, but you have to bring me a gift.
translation: 你可以来我的派对，不过，你得带来一件礼物.
author: CK

text: If you stand on this stool, you can reach the top of the closet.
translation: 站在这个凳子上的话，你可以摸到衣柜顶。
author: CK

text: If you need more room on the screen, you can toggle the sidebar off.
translation: 如需更多萤幕空间，可以关闭侧边栏。
author: shekitten

text: Please telephone me when you have made up your mind what you want to do.
translation: 你决定好要怎么做的时候就打个电话给我吧。
author: CK

text: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.

translation: 我喜欢这个工作因为它立竿见影，让人很有成就感。
author: CarpeLanam

text: I don't have a car, so I usually go to work by bicycle.
translation: 我没有车，所以我一般骑自行车去上班。
author: CK

text: Do you have any idea how hard I've studied to become a doctor?
translation: 你知道我为了成为一名医生有多么努力吗？
author: andresangelini

text: Every time I go to a Japanese restaurant, I bring the chopsticks home.
translation: 每次我去日本餐馆，我都会把筷子带回家。
author: Aphima

text: As the moon rises above the sea, we share the same time though we are far apart.
translation: 海上升明月，天涯共此时。
author: LeeSooHa

text: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.
translation: 和别人握手的时候，一定要有眼神接触。
author: CM

text: When you're done with the book, put it back where you found it.
translation: 你一用完了这本书，就把它放回原来找到的地方。
author: Zifre

text: Excuse me, but could you tell me how to get to Central Park?
translation: 不好意思，请问到中央公园要怎么走？
author: CK

text: If you stay at a big hotel, you can use their swimming pool.
translation: 若你住到的是大的酒店，就能使用他们的游泳池。
author: CK

text: You can take a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.
translation: 你可以把马带到河边可是不能迫它喝水。
author: CK

text: We can continue playing, as long as we don't make too much noise.
translation: 我们可以继续玩，别吵到别人就行了。
author: lukaszpp

text: I'm sorry, I do not understand. Can you repeat it a little slower?
translation: 对不起，我听不懂。你能慢点儿再说一遍吗？
author: katshi94

text: I'd be grateful to you if you could teach me to do that.
translation: 如果你能教我怎么做，我会很感激。
author: CK

text: Behind his house is a stream so clear that you can see the bottom of it.
translation: 他家后面有小溪，清可见底。
author: sundown

text: I'll let you off this time, but I don't ever want to catch you stealing again.
translation: 今次就原谅你吧，但我不希望再看见你偷东西。
author: CK

text: One of the lights is not working. Do you think you could come take a look?
translation: 一盏电灯不亮了，你帮我来看看好吗？
author: minshirui

text: There's something I need to tell you, and I know you're not going to like it.
translation: 有些事我要跟你说，而且我知道你不会喜欢。
author: darinmex

text: No matter how good you are, there will always be people who are better than you.
translation: 不管你有多好，都还有人比你更好。
author: eastasiastudent

text: What are you unhappy about? Let it out and let everyone cheer you up a bit.
translation: 你有什么不开心的事？说出来让大家开心一下。
author: donkirkby

text: I just want you to give me back that book you borrowed a few days ago.
translation: 我只是想要你把我前些日子借给你的书还回来。
author: JimmyUK

text: I wish I were what I was when I wished I were what I am.
translation: 我希望当我在想我希望我是谁的时候我就是谁。
author: Dany74PL

text: Even if I grant that what you say is true, it is no excuse.
translation: 即使我承认你说的是真的，但这并不是借口。
author: auxitt

text: If the Earth went into an Ice Age next month, how would you prepare?
translation: 如果地球下个月将进入冰河期，你将如何准备？
author: pig8322

text: If you dress like that at your age, you'll make a fool of yourself.
translation: 你现在这个年纪，穿成这个样子，会给人取笑的。
author: CK

text: He thinks I don't know anything about it, but, in reality, I know everything.
translation: 他以为我什么都不知道，其实我什么都知道。
author: sharris123

text: Whenever I look at this picture, I remember those happy days in the village.
translation: 每当我看著这张照片，我就回忆起那些在乡村幸福的日子。
author: mccarras

text: I prefer to look for a solution to problems, not only to report them.
translation: 我更喜欢寻求问题的解决方法，而不仅仅是揭露它们。
author: Zifre

text: Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
translation: 别忘了一到伦敦就给我们留言啊。
author: CN

text: In another two weeks you will be able to get out of the hospital.
translation: 再过两周你就可以出院了。
author: CK

text: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
translation: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百货公司的特价活动。
author: CK

text: We did not expect him to finish the task in so short a time.
translation: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。
author: CM

text: I don't think it's possible to finish that amount of work in one day.
translation: 我觉得很难用一天就做完这么多的工作。
author: phelcq

text: I'd like to get you to help me ask the teacher for time off.
translation: 我想让你帮我向老师请个假。
author: CM

text: Now's the time to decide whether you really want to get married or not.
translation: 现在是你决定是不是真要结婚的时候。
author: CK

text: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.
translation: 即使没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
author: peterius

text: I need someone to hold me and tell me everything will be all right.
translation: 我需要某人抱着我并对我说一切会顺利的。
author: CK

text: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
translation: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。
author: CM

text: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?
translation: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？
author: kroko

text: This kind of medicine can temporarily alleviate pain. If you need it, just take it.
translation: 这种药可以暂时缓解身体的疼痛，你需要的话就拿去吧。
author: trieuho

text: Lately I try for health reasons to go to bed early and to wake up early.
translation: 基于健康方面的考虑，最近我早睡早起。
author: edoreld

text: A passport is something you cannot do without when you go to a foreign country.
translation: 去外国旅行不能不带护照。
author: CM

text: If I had known that you were here, I would have come at once.
translation: 如果我早知道你在这儿的话，我马上就来了。
author: CK

text: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
translation: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。
author: CK

text: When we are told not to come, we become all the more eager to go.
translation: 让我们别来，我们就更想来了。
author: CK

text: Appreciate the little things in life - they will bring you to a bigger end target.
translation: 欣赏生活中的小事，它们的总合很是宏大。
author: tinytina

text: The journalist wanted to write an article that would draw public attention to the issue.
translation: 记者想写一篇文章，以便引起公众对那件事情的注意。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Due to lack of manpower, we need more time than expected to handle this task.
translation: 由于人力不足，我们需要比预期更多的时间来承担这项任务。
author: vicch

text: For the sake of long-term interests, we have decided to sell the development department.
translation: 为了长期利益，我们决定把开发部门卖掉。
author: vicch

text: This deal is mine, so you need to just settle down and agree with me.
translation: 这笔交易是我的，所以你需要去冷静并且同意我
author: Ishao

text: Every time I see you, I cannot help but be reminded of your mother.
translation: 我每次看到你都不禁想起你母亲来。
author: TracyPoff

text: If there is anything I can do to help your area, please tell me.
translation: 如果有什么我可以帮到你的地方，请尽管说。
author: sharris123

text: Don't believe everything you say, don't say everything you know, don't do everything you want.
translation: 不要相信你所说的一切，不要说一切你知道的事情，不要做你想做的一切。
author: DJ_Saidez

text: I love my family very much, they are the most important people in my life.
translation: 我非常爱我的家人，他们是我生活中最重要的人。
author: Lemmih

text: If I had wings, I would want to fly to your side right away.
translation: 如果我有翅膀的话，真想马上飞到你的身边。
author: LeviHighway

text: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.
translation: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
author: TRANG

text: At this rate, we're not likely to be done before the end of the week.
translation: 按照这个速度，我们不会在这周结束前完成。
author: Dejo

text: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only a page.
translation: 世界是本书，不旅游的人只看了一页。
author: Dejo

text: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".
translation: 和一个只说"是"与"否"的人维持一段对话是很难的。
author: papabear

text: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.
translation: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。
author: CM

text: If I could rearrange the alphabet, I would put U and I together.
translation: 如果我可以把英文字母重新排序，我会把「U」和「I」放在一起。
author: TRANG

text: She can't make up her mind whether to get a job or to go on to college.
translation: 她在找工作和读大学之间无法取舍。
author: papabear

text: If you can see your breath when you exhale, you know it's cold.
translation: 如果呼气的时候能看到自己的气，你就知道天气很冷。
author: darinmex

text: Black people had to sit in the back of the bus, or stand if the back was full.
translation: 黑人不得不坐在公交车的后面，如果后面的座位满了则只能站在那里。
author: papabear

text: Your problem is that you think you have to do everything your parents tell you to do.
translation: 你的问题在于，你认为你必须听从父母的一切指示。
author: CK

text: This device made it possible to turn sea-water into fresh water easily.
translation: 有了这个装置，把海水净化成淡水就不是难事了。
author: Dreamk33

text: Eventually I'd like to settle down and have a family, but not yet.
translation: 我会找个地方安顿下来，然后结婚生子的，但这是以后的事。
author: Zifre

text: I can put up with a house being untidy, but I don't like it to be dirty.
translation: 房子乱七八糟也没问题，但是肮脏的话我接受不了。
author: papabear

text: Do you want to eat noodles or rice? Do you want to drink fruit juice or coffee?
translation: 你吃面条还是吃饭？喝橙汁还是喝咖啡？
author: eastasiastudent

text: I'll use it a bit this evening, and try my best to give it back to you tomorrow.
translation: 今天晚上我先用一下，争取明天还给你。
author: eastasiastudent

text: What I have learnt is not just the Chinese language, but something about the country itself as well.
translation: 我学习的不只是中国的语言，也是一些关于这个国家的东西。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Now that we are at nearly the same level, we can start learning some piano duets.
translation: 现在我们差不多有同样的水平了，我们可以开始学习几段四手联弹。
author: sysko

text: Tom always speaks in such a low voice that I can barely understand what he says.
translation: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。
author: CK

text: Put your hard hat on. You might well get a brick fall on your head here.
translation: 把安全帽戴上。这里很可能会有砖块砸到你头上。
author: sundown

text: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.
translation: 给你解释这为什么行不通要花很多时间。
author: Zifre

text: As I missed the train, I had to wait for the next one for about an hour.
translation: 由于错过了火车，我不得不等下一班等一小时。
author: CK

text: It is a difficult task, choosing what is "right" or "wrong", but you have to do it.
translation: 选择什么是“对”或“错”是一项艰难的任务，我们却必须要完成它。
author: fcbond

text: What do you think was the most read article this year on the Japanese version of Wikipedia?
translation: 你认为今年在维基百科上被最多人阅读的日文版本的文章是哪篇？
author: Sereptie

text: Learn from the mistakes of others. You can never live long enough to make them all yourself.
translation: 从别人的错误中学习，因为你无法所有事都亲身经历一次。
author: LeeSooHa

text: If you want to make money, study English; but if you want to have friends, learn Esperanto.
translation: 想赚钱的话就学英语，但想交朋友的话就该学世界语。
author: Fenrir

text: There's quite a lot of things to do; do you want some help?
translation: 有很多事情要做。你需要我帮忙吗？
author: fcbond

text: We should read the newspaper so as not to lag behind the times.
translation: 我们应该读报纸，不落后于时代。
author: auxitt

text: We cannot tell a good person from a bad one by looks alone.
translation: 分辨一个人是好人还是坏人不能仅凭外表。
author: CK

text: How long does it take to go from here to the Hilton Hotel?
translation: 从这里到希尔顿酒店需要多长时间？
author: CK

text: We have to turn in our reports by the end of this month.
translation: 这个月底前，我们必须交报告。
author: CK

text: As far as I know, he is the shortest student in this school.
translation: 据我所知，他是这所学校最差的学生。
author: CK

text: If you don't have anything nice to say, don't say anything at all.
translation: 如果你没好话说，那就什么都别说。
author: darinmex

text: If you don't make the promise, then I'll just stand by and watch.
translation: 你要是不答应的话，我就袖手旁观。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: I haven't decided whether to study at university or to get a job.
translation: 去读大学还是去上班，我还没决定。
author: russell359

text: You always wear a ponytail. Why not try pigtails every now and then?
translation: 你总是绑马尾辫，为什么不偶尔试试双马尾呢？
author: CK

text: I have to wear earplugs to drown out all the noise from the construction site next door.
translation: 我不得不戴耳塞来阻隔旁边建筑工地的所有噪音。
author: darinmex

text: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
translation: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。
author: eastasiastudent

text: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
translation: 我想这工作粗略估计得花上两个星期的时间。
author: CM

text: I must excuse myself from the task, because I am unequal to it.
translation: 我必须推掉这任务，因为我不能胜任。
author: Dejo

text: I will have finished reading this novel by the time you come tomorrow.
translation: 你明天来的时候，我就看完这本小说了。
author: CC

text: If you ever come back to me, I'll never treat you badly again.
translation: 如果你肯回到我的身边，我一定会永远好好待你。
author: CK

text: We expressed the hope that they could go abroad again to study geography.
translation: 我们表示希望他们能再次出国学习地理。
author: eastasiastudent

text: I don't like Google Translate either, but I always use it for reference.
translation: 我也不喜欢谷歌翻译，但是我经常会使用它作为参考。
author: Aphima

text: Who else has questions? Yes, how about you there in the white shirt?
translation: 还有谁有问题？就你吧，穿白色上衣的那位。
author: frpzzd

text: I have a cat and a dog. The cat is black and the dog is white.
translation: 我养了一只猫和一只狗。猫是黑色的，狗是白色的。
author: kebukebu

text: Nothing lasts forever, not for a long time, anyone can find an excuse to go ahead.
translation: 没有什么永远，没有什么很久，找个借口谁都可以先走。
author: katshi94

text: Whether you pass the Chinese exam or not, let's go to the bar to drink beer.
translation: 不管你有没有通过中文考试，我们一起去酒吧喝啤酒。
author: n1ls

text: If anyone was to ask what the point of the story is, I really don't know.
translation: 如果有人问起这个故事的用意是什么，我还真不知道。
author: secretkingdom

text: If you want to study in the United States, you need to get a student visa.
translation: 你想去美国读书的话，一定要先申请一张学生签证。
author: kellenparker

text: I didn't know the city, and what's more, I couldn't speak a word of the language.
translation: 我不知道这个城市，而且我一点都不懂那里的语言。
author: CK

text: I'm not a child, but sometimes you talk to me as if I were a child.
translation: 我不是小孩子，但有时你跟我说话就好像我是小孩子一样。
author: CK

text: I got a phone call from him just as I was about to go to bed.
translation: 我正要上床的时候接到了他打来的电话。
author: CK

text: Unfortunately, you will return to China soon, so I will have nobody to accompany me.
translation: 可惜你很快又会回中国，没人陪我了呢。
author: sharris123

text: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
translation: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。
author: CK

text: You should apologize to your father for not getting home in time for dinner.
translation: 你应该为你没有及时回家吃晚餐向你父亲道歉。
author: CK

text: Every other day I go with a friend; we lift weights whilst chatting together.
translation: 我每隔一天就跟一个好朋友一起去，我们一起一边谈话一边举重。
author: eastasiastudent

text: If you need my advice, I'd be glad to give it to you.
translation: 如果你需要我的建议，我很愿意告诉你。
author: CK

text: A more experienced lawyer would have dealt with the case in a different way.
translation: 一个经验丰富的律师会以其它方法来处理这个情形的。
author: CK

text: It would be better for both of us not to see each other anymore.
translation: 我们还是不要再见面了。
author: CK

text: It's a good rule to look both ways before you cross the street anywhere.
translation: 无论在什么地方，过马路前也应该先看清楚左右。
author: CK

text: I'm afraid we can't rule out the possibility that she may have the disease.
translation: 恐怕我们不能排除她患了病的可能性。
author: CK

text: Some people think that eating grapefruit with every meal will help you lose weight.
translation: 有些人认为吃饭的时候吃葡萄柚会有助于减肥。
author: CK

text: I have a pretty good idea who Tom will be hanging out with tonight.
translation: 我大概知道汤姆今晚会和谁一起玩。
author: CK

text: The possibility of a lack of connection between the events can be dismissed immediately.
translation: 可以立即排除事件之间缺乏关联的可能性
author: AlanF_US

text: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.
translation: 你的歌声像太平洋的海水一样清澈。
author: peterius

text: For the sake of living things, please do not play around with the water.
translation: 关爱生命，请勿嬉水。
author: Sethlang

text: The house did not suffer much damage because the fire was quickly put out.
translation: 火很快便被扑熄了，房子只受到轻微损坏。
author: CK

text: They have eyes but they do not see - ears, and they do not hear.
translation: 他们有眼睛，但看不见；有耳朵，但听不见。
author: ulyssemc1

text: She read the letter, and so she came to learn that he was dead.
translation: 她读了信，由此得知他的死讯。
author: Ignoto

text: This area is still underdeveloped because of a lack of interest from the government.
translation: 因为缺乏的政府的关注，这个区域还不发达。
author: SHamp

text: Many people can't, and do not want to, make the effort to understand others.
translation: 许多人不能而且不想去理解别人。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.
translation: 先生，请出示护照或者身份证，让我登记一下。
author: FishlandicFishy

text: What is important is not how many books you read, but what books you read.
translation: 最重要的不是你看了多少书，而是你看的是什么书。
author: CK

text: Can you spare me a few minutes? I'd like to have a word with you.
translation: 你有几分钟时间吗？我想跟你聊一下。
author: CK

text: I noticed a note on my desk, but I do not know who wrote it.
translation: 我发现了我办公桌上有张字条，但是我不知道是谁写的。
author: hrin

text: As long as you finish eating your food, then you can play with your friends.
translation: 只要你吃完你的饭就可以跟朋友玩。
author: limmy

text: I haven't baked bread in a long time. How about we bake a little today?
translation: 我有好久都没烤面包了。要不今天烤点儿？
author: luxdelumine

text: A hot water bottle is something you must buy to prepare for the winter months.
translation: 热水袋真是冬日必备好物！
author: iiujik

text: There is no success in the world that makes up for the failure of the family.
translation: 世上没有任何的成功，能够弥补家庭的失败。
author: pan176

text: The staff at the company tried to cover up the truth, but soon it came to light.
translation: 公司的职员设法隐瞒，但真相不久便水落石出了。
author: papabear

text: On a rainy morning, he left his house early so as to be in time for school.
translation: 在一个下雨的早晨，他很早出门为的是及时到学校。
author: Lumi_alt

text: The food at this hot pot restaurant really tastes pretty good. Let's come here again next time.
translation: 这家火锅店的味道还挺不错的嘛，下次我们再来吃吧。
author: trieuho

text: We're delighted to bring this game back for the start of a new era for the series.
translation: 我们很高兴能再次推出这款游戏，并为系列作品开启全新的阶段。
author: LeviHighway

text: We must learn to live together as brothers, or we will perish together as fools.
translation: 我们必须学会像兄弟一样共同生活，要么就像傻子一样同归于尽。
author: wuiwie

text: Any universe simple enough to be understood is too simple to produce a mind able to understand it.
translation: 任何简单到可以被了解的宇宙便太过简单而无法产生可以了解它的心灵。
author: Zifre

text: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
translation: 因为空气污染的问题，也许有一天自行车会取代汽车。
author: Zifre

text: People who are not in a hurry stand on the right side of the escalator.
translation: 不赶时间的人们站在自动扶梯的右边。
author: sacredceltic

text: Every person in this community is like a cell in the immune system of a healthy human body.
translation: 这个团体内的每个人，像是一个健康的人体内免疫系统里的细胞。
author: papabear

text: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
translation: 我们需要人力仲介公司帮我们找到合适的人来担任这个管理职位。
author: CK

text: You went to bed at 2 o'clock in the morning? No wonder you look sleepy today.
translation: 你凌晨两点才去睡觉吗？难怪你今天看起来这么没精神了。
author: Zifre

text: Today I'm working a little late so as to avoid a rush in the morning.
translation: 我今天晚点下班，省得明天早上手忙脚乱。
author: kellenparker

text: When I am in London, I will most probably go catch a few performances.
translation: 我在伦敦的时候，应该会去看一两场演出。
author: xiuqin

text: This year, the speed of development in our company far exceeds that of last year.
translation: 今年我们公司的发展速度大大超过去年。
author: eastasiastudent

text: It is said that the price of wine may go up at any time now.
translation: 据说葡萄酒的价格可以随时增长。
author: CM

text: When I didn't have any money, I only had a rug for a bed.
translation: 我没有钱的时候，只能以地毯为床。
author: CM

text: If you want to criticise other people, first you must improve your own methods.
translation: 要是你想批评别人的话，首先需要改进自己的做法。
author: eastasiastudent

text: It will make you think about the things you think about in your thoughts.
translation: 它会让你思考起在你思想里考虑的事情。
author: BraveSentry

text: Does one of you want to come here and redo what I just did?
translation: 是不是你们其中一个人要来这里重做我才刚做过的？
author: odiernod

text: He cut it with the knife that he received as a present from his brother.
translation: 他用哥哥送给他的刀子切开了。
author: CM

text: If I'd known that it would come to this, I would have never consented.
translation: 要是我知道会发生这种事，那我死活不同意。
author: Lepotdeterre

text: Anne, go and stand on the platform in front of the blackboard for the rest of the afternoon.
translation: 安妮，妳下午剩下的时间就站在黑板前的平台上。
author: Hybrid

text: Man will only become better when you make him see what he is like.
translation: 只有当你让人看见他是什么德性他才会变好。
author: Hybrid

text: You might get fired if you do that the way Tom told you to.
translation: 你要是照着汤姆告诉你的办法做，你有可能会被开除的。
author: CK

text: Bicycles wear out, of course, but with proper care they may be made to last a long time.
translation: 自行车当然会磨损，但只要你保养得好，就能骑很长一段时间。
author: Maria_E_Ward

text: He that buys what he does not want, must often sell what he does want.
translation: 买了不想要的东西，往往得要卖掉想要的东西。
author: carlosalberto

text: This is the house where I used to live when I was young.
translation: 这是我年轻时候住的房子。
author: CK

text: I'm sorry I wasn't able to see you when you came by today.
translation: 我很抱歉今天您来的时候没能见您。
author: CK

text: I don't know what you are trying to say, but I like it.
translation: 我不知道你想讲的是什么，但是我喜欢。
author: JimmyUK

text: There is a room where children play. You can take your child there.
translation: 这里有间供儿童玩耍的房间。你可以把你的小孩带到那里。
author: tokzyk

text: I guess what I've said isn't all that clear, but that's the only way I can explain it.
translation: 总觉得解释的不是很清楚...但我只知道这样...
author: richwarm

text: I haven't seen you for ages. Do you remember when I saw you last?
translation: 好久不见了。记得上次我什么时候看见你的吗？
author: CK

text: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
translation: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。
author: CK

text: When I was growing up, I never imagined that I would become famous.
translation: 我小的时候从没想过自己会出名。
author: CK

text: We are going to eat a lot tonight so I hope that you are not on a diet.
translation: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。
author: qdii

text: If you want to have an attractive personality, you need to have a good head on your shoulders.
translation: 要想有良好的人格魅力，必须要有聪慧的头脑。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: As soon as I came I washed the dishes, so how come you ask me to leave?!
translation: 我一来就在洗碗，你凭什么叫我走！
author: MichelTesmon

text: When you go abroad, it is useful to learn at least some polite phrases in the local language.
translation: 你出国的时候学一些当地的礼貌用语还是很有用的。
author: iris

text: It's gotten late, so you better hurry up and sleep. You still need to go to work tomorrow.
translation: 已经很晚了，快睡觉吧，明天还要工作的。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: The almond tree says to the snow: "Either you make it all white, or you make us white".
translation: 杏树对雪说：「要么你把一切都变成白色，要么你把我们也变成白色。」
author: AmarMecheri

text: If you want to sell your old sofa, why not put an advertisement in the local paper?
translation: 你若打算卖掉旧沙发，何不在本地报纸上登个广告呢？
author: trieuho

text: I told Tom it would be dangerous to do that, but he still wanted to do it.
translation: 我和汤姆说过那样做很危险，但他还是想那样做。
author: CK

text: Before you put the noodles in the pot, you have to break them up into small pieces.
translation: 面条下锅前要先掰成小块。
author: sharris123

text: I prefer Noh to Kabuki because I find the former to be more elegant than the latter.
translation: 比起歌舞伎，我更喜欢能乐表演，因为我觉得后者比前者优雅。
author: bekindtoall

text: Let's go drink a cup of coffee at that coffee shop over there.
translation: 我们去那间咖啡店喝杯咖啡吧。
author: CK

text: The flow of the water was strong enough to wash away the bridge.
translation: 水流的强力把桥给冲垮了。
author: sharris123

text: If you concentrate all your energies on the study of English, you will master the language.
translation: 你如果能把全副精力放进去，要学会英文并不是难事。
author: CK

text: Regardless how many times I try to solve this nasty problem, I always end up failing.
translation: 对于这个棘手的问题，无论我尝试多少次，结果都会以失败告终。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: On behalf of the company, I would like to express our hearty thanks to you all.
translation: 在此仅代表本公司向各位致上衷心的谢意。
author: CK

text: Merry Christmas! What right have you to be merry? What reason have you to be merry?
translation: 圣诞节快乐！你有什么权利快乐？你有什么理由快乐？
author: Hybrid

text: How many times do I have to ask you to put your laundry in the basket?
translation: 就您把您的脏衣服放到篮子里我还需要说几次呀？
author: Hybrid

text: I don't have a lot of work, but it's enough to keep me in the office this week.
translation: 其实我工作并不多，但足以让我这周在办公室里忙着了。
author: paper1n0

text: Should anyone call on me in my absence, tell him that I will be back soon.
translation: 如果我不在的时候有人来找我，麻烦你告诉他我很快回来。
author: CM

text: One of the great mysteries of life is how a cat decides what to do next.
translation: 生活的伟大奥秘其中之一是猫如何决定下一步要做什么。
author: afyodor

text: I'm completely soaked from the rain. Can you drive over and pick me up right now?
translation: 我浑身都被雨水给淋湿了。你现在能不能开车来接我？
author: FeuDRenais2

text: If the cedars have caught fire, what will the hyssops that grow out of the wall say?
translation: 如果雪松著火了，从墙里长出来的牛膝草会说什么呢？
author: MrShoval

text: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
translation: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。
author: paper1n0

text: Then come with me for a moment. Let's check the warehouse. We might just find it there.
translation: 那您随我来一趟，咱们去仓库里找一找，说不定那里会有。
author: LeviHighway

text: To know a language is one thing, and to teach it is another.
translation: 知道一门语言是一回事，教这门语言又是另一回事。
author: timmartin

text: If there is somebody to back me up, the business will be successful.
translation: 如果有人支持的话，生意是会成功的。
author: CM

text: The boy gave up his seat to the old man on the bus.
translation: 男孩在公交车上把座位让给了老人。
author: CK

text: Like any company, we've got to look ahead and plan for the future.
translation: 和其他公司一样，我们得向前看，规划好未来。
author: CM

text: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.
translation: 他买土地的目的是要造房子。
author: CK

text: Scott first changed a watch for a book, then the book for money.
translation: Scott先用一只手表换了一本书，再把书换成钱。
author: Scott

text: This place still looks the same as it did a long time ago.
translation: 这里就像在古时候一样。
author: itsthejazzkid

text: Since he was able to walk so far, he must have strong legs.
translation: 他走了那么远的路，脚力一定很不错。
author: CK

text: She's the kind of person who likes to turn everything into a competition.
translation: 她是个任何事情都喜欢和别人一比高下的人。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
translation: 最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。
author: wzhd

text: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent right away.
translation: 如遇情况紧急，请立即联系我的代理。
author: mcq

text: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.
translation: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
author: CK

text: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.
translation: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。
author: CK

text: Your plan to purchase another PC will not be a problem at all.
translation: 您购买另一台电脑的计划完全不会有问题。
author: cafe

text: You might as well read a novel instead of staring at the ceiling.
translation: 望着天花板发呆，还不如读一读小说。
author: CM

text: It may not be clean, but you won't get sick from eating it.
translation: 不干不净，吃了没病。
author: FeuDRenais

text: I got up earlier than usual in order to catch the first train.
translation: 我比平时起得早，好赶上第一班车。
author: CK

text: Is it true that you authorized the driver to take the car home?
translation: 你批准司机把车开回家的事是真的吗？
author: Amastan

text: Suddenly unable to make up her mind, she didn't know what to do.
translation: 她一时间拿不定主意，不知如何是好。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: We have come to the conclusion that this plan is not feasible currently.
translation: 我们得出结论，这个计划目前是不可行的。
author: vicch

text: If a relationship has to be a secret, you shouldn't be in it.
translation: 如果一个浪漫关系需要保密，你不应该做了。
author: fekundulo

text: I admit that this may not be the best way of doing it.
translation: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
author: CK

text: He did everything to be able to survive, hence he never wants to talk about it.
translation: 他为了活下去竭尽全力，所以他从来不想谈起这件事。
author: LimeGreenTeknii

text: I feel a little guilty that I didn't invite him to join the celebration.
translation: 我没请他来参加庆祝会，感到有点内疚。
author: Mouseneb

text: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
translation: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。
author: CK

text: If you want something to be done right, sometimes you've just got to do it yourself.
translation: 如果你想做对一件事，有时候你得亲力亲为。
author: Spamster

text: He’d heard this more than once, but once was once more than he could bear.
translation: 这些话，他听过不止一次，唯其不止一次，才忍无可忍。
author: eastasiastudent

text: In any case, just tell me if you want to come to Tianjin for a vacation.
translation: 反正你想来天津玩跟我说。
author: ColawithIce

text: If I had known about your illness, I could have visited you in the hospital.
translation: 如果我知道你病了，怎么也会赶来看你的。
author: CK

text: I intend to devote a few hours a day to the study of English.
translation: 我打算每天花几个小时来学英文。
author: CK

text: I only had a piece of toast and a cup of coffee this morning.
translation: 我今天早上只吃了一块吐司和喝了一杯咖啡。
author: _undertoad

text: I was in such a hurry that I forgot to lock the door.
translation: 我太著急了，忘了锁门。
author: CK

text: Could you lend me some money? I'm short of cash at the moment.
translation: 可以借点钱给我吗？我现在有点缺钱。
author: CK

text: The plane was about to take off when I heard a strange sound.
translation: 飞机快要起飞的时候，我听到了一个奇怪的声音。
author: CK

text: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
translation: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
author: fcbond

text: Funny... Someone just added the sentence that I mentioned to you this afternoon.
translation: 好巧，我下午和你说过的一句话，刚才有人添加了。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
translation: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
author: CK

text: Since there is no air on the moon, there is no sound at all.
translation: 月球上没有空气，也自然没有声音。
author: CK

text: The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
translation: 政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。
author: CK

text: The ground is still wet. As likely as not, the game will be cancelled.
translation: 地面仍然很湿滑，看来比赛要被取消了。
author: CN

text: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
translation: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个俱乐部的成员。
author: CK

text: Astronomy is at the same time the most ancient and the most modern science.
translation: 天文学同时是最古老也最现代的科学。
author: marcelostockle

text: The problem is that the money is not of such importance as the time.
translation: 问题在于，金钱没有时间那样重要。
author: shanghainese

text: In this kind of weather, it's best to stay home and not go outside.
translation: 这种天气下最好待在家里不要外出。
author: CK

text: The main type of tree in this part of the forest is the cypress.
translation: 这片森林的树主要是柏树。
author: sharris123

text: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
translation: 蛋糕应该差不多可以出炉了。
author: CK

text: Can we please have two cups of tea and one cup of coffee?
translation: 请来两杯茶和一杯咖啡。
author: NickC

text: A-che, did you see my phone? I think I left it on your desk just now.
translation: 阿哲你有没有看到我手机？我刚刚好像放在你桌上。
author: LeviHighway

text: We'll most likely go, but we'll decide once we see what the weather is like.
translation: 我们大概去了，不过要看天气怎么样再决定。
author: minshirui

text: I couldn't take my eyes off of you from the minute I entered this room.
translation: 从我走进这房间的那一刻开始，我的视线就不能再从你的身上移开了。
author: TRANG

text: Everyone here already seems to be with a partner... what am I going to do?
translation: 这里的所有人似乎都已经和伙伴在一起了...那我接下来应该怎么做？
author: Ishao

text: Forks go to the left side of the plate, and knives go to the right.
translation: 叉子放在盘子的左边，刀子放在右边。
author: Hybrid

text: If I had to be your husband, I'd rather hang myself on the first tree.
translation: 如果非要我当你的丈夫，我宁愿上吊死在第一棵树上。
author: maaster

text: Please stay on the line while your call is transferred to a customer service representative.
translation: 您的电话正在转接给客服代表，请不要挂断。
author: rul

text: When I was little, I often lay on the grass and watched the white clouds in the sky.
translation: 我小时候常常躺在草地上看天上的白云。
author: LeviHighway

text: If you think education is expensive, wait till you see what ignorance costs you.
translation: 如果你认为教育是昂贵的，那么你等著看无知让你付出的代价。
author: Zifre

text: When I left the shopping center, the car wasn't where I had left it.
translation: 我离开购物中心时，发现车不在原来停放的地方。
author: garborg

text: It is not until you go abroad that you realize how small Japan is.
translation: 你出国看看，才会知道日本是多么的细小。
author: CK

text: If you had left home a little earlier you would have been in time.
translation: 如果你早点出门的话，你就能赶上了。
author: CK

text: I have to brush up my French before I go to Paris to study.
translation: 我去巴黎读书之前要先练好我的法文。
author: CN

text: I have lost my umbrella somewhere in the park. I have to buy one.
translation: 我的雨伞遗失在公园里某个地方。我必须再买一把。
author: CK

text: What place on Earth could be better than the place your people came from?
translation: 世界上有什么地方能比得上你的故乡好啊？
author: fenfang557

text: Otherwise you should visit Switzerland by yourself, while my sister and I visit Estonia.
translation: 不然你自己去瑞士玩，我跟姊姊去爱沙尼亚。
author: BobbyLee

text: If you don't have anything to do, look at the ceiling of your room.
translation: 如果你没事做，那就看你房间的天花板。
author: orcrist

text: I wonder if you don't get tired of doing the same thing every day.
translation: 你每天都是做一模一样的东西，难道不会觉得闷吗？
author: Dejo

text: If it's at all possible, I'd like you to take part in the next meeting.
translation: 如果可能的话，我希望你参加下一次的会议。
author: CK

text: If you don't know what the word means, look it up in the dictionary.
translation: 若你不懂词义，就在辞典上查阅一下吧。
author: CK

text: We need someone to keep an eye on our baby while we are away.
translation: 我们不在的时候，需要有人照看婴儿。
author: CK

text: Will you have a little time this weekend to help me with my French?
translation: 这个周末你可以抽点时间教我法文吗？
author: CK

text: I'm doing some history research and would like to ask you a few questions.
translation: 我正在做一些历史研究工作，想问您几个问题。
author: eastasiastudent

text: If there even are people more beautiful than you, there won't be many of them.
translation: 即使有人比你漂亮，也不会太多。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Although it seems very difficult to study Chinese, it's not as hard as you think.
translation: 尽管中文学起来不容易，可是比你想的简单。
author: eastasiastudent

text: In China, you have to go to the departure station and buy train tickets there.
translation: 在中国，人人必须去出发的火车站买车票。
author: eastasiastudent

text: When I'm feeling low, I talk with friends or go out for a walk.
translation: 觉得难过的时候，我会跟朋友谈心或出去散步。
author: CM

text: You don't need to tell me. I don't have any interest in this matter.
translation: 你不需要告诉我，我对这件事情没兴趣。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: In order to move the project along smoothly, we have revised the plan several times.
translation: 为了顺利推进项目，我们已经修订了几次计划。
author: vicch

text: I plan to accept the offer from that company to become their marketing department's manager.
translation: 我打算去应聘那个公司的营销部经理职位.
author: thomasstrand

text: It took us a long time to decide what we really wanted to do.
translation: 我们花了很长时间决定我们真正要做的事。
author: CK

text: I wonder whether we have enough money to buy Tom the painting he wanted.
translation: 我想知道咱们是否有足够的钱给汤姆买他想要的这幅画。
author: CK

text: Mary said she thought she might have to do that before she can go home.
translation: 玛丽说她以为必须先完成这件事才能回家。
author: CF

text: English is still a foreign language to me, even though I speak it every day.
translation: 尽管我每天都说英文，但它对我来说还是外语。
author: nonong

text: We help for free. If someone wants money from you, they are a scammer.
translation: 我们提供免费援助，如果有人想从你这得到钱，那就是骗子。
author: tokzyk

text: I don't speak your language, so just answer questions with “yes” or “no” only.
translation: 我不会说你的语言，所以你只要回答我“是”或“不”。
author: tokzyk

text: When I was a little child, I used to play baseball after school.
translation: 我小孩子时，我放学时打棒球了。
author: CN

text: I told him, once and for all, that I would not marry him.
translation: 我告诉他，我永远不会嫁给他。
author: CK

text: I used to go swimming in the sea when I was a child.
translation: 童年时我会去海里游泳。
author: gizem

text: We were talking about something at that time, but I don't remember what.
translation: 我们那时在谈论事情，但我不记得是什么了。
author: CK

text: We need you to tell us why you were absent all last week.
translation: 我们要你告诉我们你为什么整个上周都缺勤。
author: CM

text: From my room in Brooklyn I can see all the way to Manhattan.
translation: 我能从布鲁克林的房间看到曼哈顿。
author: Hybrid

text: I wonder what made Tom think I don't have to do that again.
translation: 我好奇汤姆凭什么认为我不需要在那样做。
author: CK

text: When considering the party, what kind of clothes are you going to wear?
translation: 参加派对的话，你会穿哪一件衣服？
author: sharris123

text: When you come back from the United States, I will have already graduated.
translation: 当你从美国回来时，我已经毕业了。
author: bekindtoall

text: I'll keep your phone number in case I need to contact you later.
translation: 我会将您的电话号码记下来，方便以后联系。
author: LeviHighway

text: I guess we wouldn't have been able to carry out the plan if it weren't for your help.
translation: 若没你的帮助，我们大概无法实行这个计划吧。
author: aliene

text: There are four seasons in a year, and the one I like most is summer. How about you?
translation: 一年四季，我最喜欢夏天，你呢？
author: FeuDRenais2

text: I know that you've been waiting a long time, but could you wait just a little bit longer?
translation: 我知道你已经等很久了，但你能再等一小会吗？
author: CK

text: If I had worked hard in my youth, I would be successful now.
translation: 如果我年轻的时候努力工作，我现在就成功了。
author: CN

text: But where do we get those sentences? And how do we translate them?
translation: 但我们从哪儿弄到那些句子？我们又要如何翻译呢？
author: jakov

text: Happiness is probably wanting what you already have, not having what you want.
translation: 幸福应该是想要你已经有的东西，而不是拥有你想要的东西。
author: eastasiastudent

text: What kind of reaction did you have when he came looking for you?
translation: 他来找你的时候，当时你是什么反应？
author: trieuho

text: You can't judge a person by appearance, just as you can't measure the sea with a pint pot.
translation: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量。
author: gleki

text: I don't like it when mathematicians who know much more than I do can't express themselves explicitly.
translation: 我不喜欢那些数学家知道的比我多得多，却不知道清楚地表达自己。
author: fcbond

text: You may not agree with some of their major policies and this could affect your working relationship.
translation: 你也许不同意他们某些重大政策，这可能会影响你的工作关系。
author: eastasiastudent

text: I'm pretty sure Tom is the only one who can tell us what we need to know.
translation: 我很确定，汤姆是唯一能告诉我们我们需要知道的事情的人。
author: CK

text: I ate a bunch of Taco Bell and now I have a serious case of the shits.
translation: 我吃了一堆塔可钟，现在肚子拉得很惨。
author: frpzzd

text: Next time you talk back to me like that, I'm grounding you on the spot, young lady.
translation: 你下次再这样顶嘴，我就禁足你，小姐。
author: frpzzd

text: Thank you for taking some time out of your busy schedule to reply to my letter.
translation: 谢谢您在百忙之中抽出时间回复我的信件。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: I'm not a woman hater; and if I were, I would make an exception for you.
translation: 我不是一个厌恶女性的人; 但如果我是，我会为你而破例。
author: Dorenda

text: If you'd listen a little more carefully to what the teacher says, you'd probably be able to understand.
translation: 假如你在老师讲课的时候再集中一点去听讲的话，你应该就能弄明白了。
author: CK

text: He is very popular, so whenever you find yourself in trouble, his friends will be happy to help.
translation: 他的人缘向来很好，因此一旦遭遇急难，朋友都乐意帮忙。
author: sharris123

text: Therefore, for the glorious God, you must accept each other, and accept Jesus Christ in the same way.
translation: 所以，为了荣耀上帝，你们要彼此接纳，就像基督接纳你们一样。
author: sharris123

text: Do you have an objection to the source, or a relevant piece of evidence to refute the claim?
translation: 你是对来源有异议，还是有相关的证据可以反驳这个说法呢？
author: shekitten

text: I wish everyone luck in the coming year, as well as success in their work and studies.
translation: 祝各位来年好运，学习事业成功。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.
translation: 不能按时交付货款的话会给客户带来很大损失。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: Can an omnipotent God create a stone so heavy that even He may not lift it?
translation: 万能的神能不能创造一块重得连祂自己也拿不起的石头呢？
author: Scott

text: Lucy might be able to help you, if you can't cook dinner for ten people alone.
translation: 露西也许能帮你的忙，如果你一人做不来十个人的晚饭。
author: CN

text: My colleague and I do the same job, but she was promised a promotion very soon.
translation: 我和我别的同事做同样的事情，但是得到了能在很短时间内得到晋升的承诺。
author: sharris123

text: It doesn't matter if you have no money left in your pocket. Go to the ATM.
translation: 口袋里的钱摸空了没关系，去找自动取款机吧。
author: LeeSooHa

text: All things considered, I think you should go back home and take care of your parents.
translation: 全盘考虑后，我觉得你应该回家，照顾你的父母。
author: CK

text: If you make fun of our company again, we certainly won’t be polite to you.
translation: 你要是再给我们公司出洋相，我可就不客气了。
author: peterius

text: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.
translation: 这里除了恶劣的天气和频繁的地震之外，几乎就是一个完美的居住地。
author: CK

text: It is generally accepted that a person cannot be successful in life without a lot of hard work.
translation: 人们普遍认为吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。
author: papabear

text: Ronaldo shot the ball right into the back of the net to score the winning goal.
translation: 罗纳尔多一脚射门，打进制胜一球。
author: trieuho

text: Once the work is done, usually around half past five, I come home to have dinner.
translation: 做完工作一般是五点半回到家里吃晚饭。
author: papabear

text: In this kind of weather it's best if I stay at home and don't go outside.
translation: 在这种天气下，我最好是待在家里而不要出去。
author: garborg

text: Remember to check to make sure the gas has been turned off before you go out.
translation: 出门前记得检查一下煤气是否关好了。
author: LeeSooHa

text: Every now and then he drops in at this bookstore on his way home from the office.
translation: 有时从办公室回家的路上他会到这家书店看一看。
author: CK

text: Tom thought that he had a chance to make a lot of money on the stock market.
translation: 汤姆觉得他有机会在股市赚一大笔钱。
author: CK

text: The only thing that socialists understand about money is that they want to take it from others.
translation: 社会主义者们对于金钱所唯一知道的事是他们想拿走他人的金钱。
author: DJ_Saidez

text: Customers who purchase a new device can enjoy additional trial period as a promotional offer.
translation: 购买新装置的用户可享有额外试用优惠。
author: LeviHighway

text: It was a pleasant day, but there were few people in the park.
translation: 那天天气很好，但公园里人并不多。
author: CK

text: No person by that name is listed in the register of the school.
translation: 学校的名册里没有这个名字的人。
author: AlanF_US

text: It is yet to be seen whether this plan will succeed or not.
translation: 这个计划能否成功还不得而知。
author: CM

text: The phone call was a trick to get him out of the house.
translation: 那通电话是引他离开房子的一个小把戏。
author: CK

text: He is sure to pass the exam if he studies at this rate.
translation: 他保持现在这种速度温习的话，考试合格绝对没问题。
author: CM

text: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
translation: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。
author: CK

text: Not that he couldn't, but he's too lazy a man to do it.
translation: 却不是不能作而是他这个男人太懒了。
author: U2FS

text: They are often together, and go to the opera or visit art galleries.
translation: 他们经常在一块儿，去看歌剧或者浏览画廊。
author: eastasiastudent

text: A water drop hollows a stone not by force but by falling often.
translation: 滴水穿石，不是靠力量，而是靠时间。
author: mhenderson5

text: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
translation: 公司从下个月开始推行新的管理制度。
author: trieuho

text: In a month, the weather won't be as hot as it is now.
translation: 一个月后，天气就不会像现在这么热了。
author: weihaiping

text: Tom left early this morning, so he should be in Boston by now.
translation: 汤姆今天早上走得很早，所以现在应该已经到波士顿了。
author: CK

text: The radical in the Chinese character for "good" is the character for "woman".
translation: “好”的部首是女。
author: BRW

text: Many people change themselves, but nobody has a way of changing the world.
translation: 很多人改变了自己，却没办法改变世界。
author: sharris123

text: The same sign may be interpreted differently by different people or different cultures.
translation: 同一个符号，不同的人或不同的文化可能会有不同的解读。
author: CM

text: She will only go to bed after she finishes reading this short essay.
translation: 她看完这篇短文后才会去睡觉。
author: Drwhooooo

text: This kind of question doesn't actually have an absolutely right or wrong answer.
translation: 这种问题的答案倒没有绝对的对错。
author: frpzzd

text: Poor is not the one who has too little, but the one who wants too much.
translation: 贫穷的不是拥有太少的人，而是想要太多的人。
author: AlanF_US

text: A man is as old as he feels and a woman as old as she looks.
translation: 男人老不老，自己心中有数;女人老不老，别人一目了然.
author: CK

text: It seems to be difficult for her to get along with students in the new school.
translation: 她和新学校的同学好像不怎么合得来。
author: CK

text: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
translation: 我知道不太可能有人愿意帮助我。
author: CK

text: Before welcoming a beautiful tomorrow, every rich man will ensure that he gets sufficient rest!
translation: 在迎接美好的明天前，每个富有的人一定会确保自己有充分地休息！
author: omfgitsasalmon

text: A small road ran across the bridge, through the fields, and over a hill.
translation: 一条小路跨过桥梁，穿过田野，还爬上小丘。
author: spockofvulcan

text: Look guys, the window and even the kitchen door have both been left open!
translation: 你们看，窗开着，厨房门也没关！
author: paper1n0

text: No need to trouble yourself, Auntie. A glass of boiled water will be plenty.
translation: 阿姨，您别客气，喝杯开水就行。
author: luxdelumine

text: We have to win seven times in a row to win this tournament.
translation: 我们要连胜七局，才能在这场锦标赛中夺得冠军。
author: CK

text: Not everyone likes to drink tea. Take me, for example. I like coffee.
translation: 不是每个人都喜欢喝茶，就拿我喜欢咖啡 来说。
author: Aharlekyn

text: Work is so busy that I don't even have any time to relax.
translation: 工作很忙，连休息的时间都没有。
author: sapphrein

text: We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
translation: 我们说我们所知道的，为我们所看到的作证；你们却不接受我们的见证。
author: wwkudu

text: It was only much later that I came to understand the importance of child education.
translation: 很久以后我才明白到教育儿童有多重要。
author: CM

text: When he reached the station, the train had already left almost half an hour before.
translation: 他到了火车站的时候，火车已经开出了差不多半小时。
author: CK

text: I don't believe that some day a majority of the world's population will speak Esperanto.
translation: 我不太相信将来的一天世界上大多数人都会讲世界语。
author: BraveSentry

text: If you don't know what your goal is, you'll never be able to achieve it.
translation: 如果你不知道你的目标是什么，那么你永远不能完成它。
author: bluepie88

text: Regarding the question at hand, can I give you an answer in two days' time?
translation: 关于该问题的答复，我两天后再回答你可以吗？
author: FeuDRenais2

text: I try not to laugh at my own jokes, but we all know I'm hilarious.
translation: 我尽量不对我自己的笑话发笑，但是我们都知道我很搞笑。
author: Adelpa

text: All social interactions, naturally, will involve some degree of insincerity, which I believe is necessary.
translation: 所有的社交，自然而然地，都会掺入一些虚伪的成分，我想这是有其必要的。
author: Drwhooooo

text: This job still has to be done by me. No one else can handle it.
translation: 这活儿还得俺来弄，别人可不行。
author: LeviHighway

text: Teach me how to fold a paper crane. I forgot how to fold it.
translation: 教我怎么折纸鹤吧。我忘记怎么折了。
author: Scott

text: I don't plan to hang out tonight. I need to prepare for my lessons.
translation: 我今晚不准备出去玩，我要预备功课。
author: sysko

text: Have you decided whether you are going into town by bike or by bus?
translation: 你决没决定骑自行车还是坐公共汽车去城里？
author: aeriph

text: I'll have to get my parent's permission to go to the dance with you.
translation: 我要得到爸爸妈妈的批准，才能和你一起去参加舞会。
author: darinmex

text: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
translation: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。
author: CK

text: You may write in any language you want. On Tatoeba, all languages are equal.
translation: 你可以用任何你想要用的语言写。在Tatoeba，所有语言都是平等的。
author: TRANG

text: If you discover any problems on Tatoeba, you should go ahead and blame Sysko.
translation: 你要是在Tatoeba上发现什么问题，你应该责备Sysko才对。
author: FeuDRenais2

text: Before you can board the plane, you'll have to go through airport security checks.
translation: 你要通过了机场的安全检查才能登机。
author: alphafour

text: Are you going to eat here or do you want us to wrap it?
translation: 您是在这儿用餐，还是给您打包带走？
author: Eldad

text: The world is not so bad. Of course, it is better when you succeed.
translation: 世界不是如此糟糕，当然，你成功后，他会更美好。
author: sharris123

text: You can talk to him in plain English and he still won't get it.
translation: 你就算用最简单的话跟他说，他还是听不懂。
author: frpzzd

text: When using the escalator, please hold the handrail and stand within the yellow line.
translation: 在乘坐扶梯时，请握住扶手，并站在黄线内。
author: LeviHighway

text: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
translation: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。
author: CK

text: There used to be a big cherry tree at the back of my house.
translation: 我家后面曾经有棵大樱桃树。
author: Dejo

text: The machine was too complicated for us to find out the cause of the trouble.
translation: 机器结构很复杂，我们找来找去也找不到故障的原因。
author: CM

text: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.
translation: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。
author: CK

text: I went to every modern art show that took place in Tokyo last year.
translation: 东京去年举行的现代艺术展，我全都去过了。
author: CK

text: She is popular not because she is beautiful, but because she is kind to everyone.
translation: 她受人欢迎，不是因为她漂亮，而是因为她人很好。
author: kebukebu

text: If I win the lottery, I'll be able to live high on the hog.
translation: 如果我中了彩劵，就一辈子衣食无忧了。
author: CK

text: If I have time and enough money, I'd want to go traveling in Europe.
translation: 如果我有时间有钱，我要到欧洲去旅游。
author: minshirui

text: If I go to China, it'd be to speak Chinese as much as possible.
translation: 如果我去中国的话，是为了尽可能多地说中文。
author: sysko

text: Even if that restaurant did very tasty food, I wouldn't like to eat there.
translation: 即使那家饭馆做的菜好吃极了，我也不想在那里吃饭。
author: eastasiastudent

text: The world is like a book, and those who don't travel read only one page.
translation: 世界就像一本书，不旅游的人只读了一页。
author: sctld

text: She was able to be ready early this morning, because she finished packing last night.
translation: 她昨晚已经收拾好行李，所以今天早上没费多少工夫就准备好出门。
author: CK

text: The rooms in this hotel are not as clean as the rooms in that hotel.
translation: 这个酒店的房间不像那个酒店的房间那么干净。
author: Mouseneb

text: I do not know whether to take it as a compliment or an insult.
translation: 我真是哭笑不得。
author: aka_aj

text: He is going to take charge of a project concerning the future of the company.
translation: 他将要负责一个关系公司前途的项目。
author: vicch

text: Everyone agrees to stay here for the night and make long-term itinerary decisions tomorrow.
translation: 大家同意先在这里住一晚，行程的事情明天再从长计议。
author: trieuho

text: In life, you gain and lose things, but also can't force things to happen.
translation: 在人生中，你将会收获和失去，当时你不会强迫事情去发生
author: oliviya

text: Tom got to the station in time to catch the train he wanted to catch.
translation: 汤姆及时赶到了车站搭上了他想搭的那列车。
author: CK

text: Tomorrow, I want to go to Madrid. It is the capital city of Spain.
translation: 我明天要去马德里，也就是西班牙的首都。
author: sharris123

text: It is very difficult to work with people who are not willing to do so.
translation: 跟不情愿的人很难一起工作。
author: sharris123

text: Did you know that there used to be a Chinese restaurant on Park Street?
translation: 你知道公园街上往前有家中餐馆吗？
author: CK

text: I'm very tired, but I can't seem to bring myself to go to sleep.
translation: 我很累，但无法让自己入睡。
author: shekitten

text: A lot of people can't go home for Lunar New Year because of the pandemic.
translation: 因疫情许多人不能回家过春节。
author: bekindtoall

text: In the end, I did manage to become friends with benefits with that girl.
translation: 最后我成功和那个女孩成为了炮友关系。
author: Aphima

text: That apple is still green. Best leave it a while before you eat it.
translation: 那颗苹果还是绿的，最好放一会儿再吃。
author: sundown

text: I may be antisocial, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.
translation: 我或许不善于社交，但这并不意味我不和别人交谈。
author: wuiwie

text: It is kind of you go out of your way to help me.
translation: 感谢你特地来帮我。
author: CK

text: If it were not for examinations, how happy our school life would be!
translation: 如果不用考试，我们的校园生活该有多快乐啊！
author: CM

text: You must have been surprised to meet your teacher in such a place.
translation: 在那种地方碰到你的老师，你应该很惊讶吧。
author: darinmex

text: I saw a group of foreigners on my way to school this morning.
translation: 今天早上在去学校的路上，我看到了一群外国人。
author: CK

text: I can't remember the meaning of the word that I looked up yesterday.
translation: 我记不起昨天查的那个词的意思了。
author: CK

text: The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.
translation: 前几天人生第一次去钓鱼了。
author: CK

text: I don't know about the past, but now we have faxes and emails.
translation: 我不知道以前怎样，但现在我们有传真和电子邮件。
author: CM

text: What have I got to do so that you'll pay attention to me?
translation: 我该怎么做才能让你更注意我？
author: lukaszpp

text: Then arose the question of where we were to get the necessary machinery.
translation: 于是出现了一个问题，哪里能找我们需要的机器。
author: eastasiastudent

text: You don't need to tell Tom how to do it. He already knows.
translation: 你不用告诉汤姆该怎么做。他已经知道了。
author: CK

text: Why haven't you gone to sleep yet? You should go to sleep sooner.
translation: 为什么现在还没有睡？早些睡觉吧。
author: JSakuragi

text: Hey, what in the world am I going to major in at college?
translation: 诶，我大学到底要修什么啊？
author: rayshih715

text: If you have other problems, please send them to me through the form.
translation: 如果你有其他问题，请通过表格发给我。
author: sharris123

text: Do you think that you are qualified for that aspect of the work?
translation: 你认为可以胜任那些方面的工作？
author: sharris123

text: Before taking action, make sure you are clear about what the goal is.
translation: 开始行动之前，一定要清楚目标是什么。
author: LeviHighway

text: Do you plan to return to your home country or to continue staying in the Netherlands after graduating?
translation: 毕业后打算回国还是继续留在荷兰呢？
author: francaisr0wlet

text: When you're beginning to look like the photo in your passport, you should go on a holiday.
translation: 当我们开始像自己护照上的照片时，我们该去度假了。
author: Dejo

text: There's no point saying "Hi, how are you?" to me if you have nothing else to say.
translation: 如果你没有其它可说的，那对我说“嗨，你怎么样？”就毫无意义。
author: Zifre

text: When I heard that song, it reminded me of when I was a kid.
translation: 我一听到那首歌，就想起来我小的时候。
author: CK

text: Why didn't you call me? I would have picked you up at the airport.
translation: 你怎么不给我打电话呢？不然我就去机场接你了。
author: kupo033

text: If I lost my key, I wouldn't be able to lock the door.
translation: 如果我弄丢了我的钥匙，我就无法锁门了。
author: CK

text: What have you done with my pen? It was here a minute ago.
translation: 你把我的钢笔怎么了？一分钟前它还在这里。
author: CK

text: Do you have difficulty understanding what women or small children say to you?
translation: 你难以理解女人和小孩子对你说的话吗？
