translation: 他没法生火，只好把鱼生吃。
author: ToxicFriu

text: Though she wished to travel abroad by herself, she thought better of it.
translation: 尽管她想过一个人去国外旅行，她改变了主意。
author: auxitt

text: It is the greatest happiness in life to love and to be loved.
translation: 爱和被爱是生活中最大的幸福。
author: speedwell

text: From the practical point of view, there are many shortcomings in his plan.
translation: 从现实的角度看，他的计划有很多缺点。
author: CM

text: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.
translation: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。
author: CM

text: Every function should have comments describing its purpose in order to avoid confusion.
translation: 每一个函数都应该有描述其目的的注释以避免误解。
author: vicch

text: The plan is to recruit 5 Java engineers before the end of next month.
translation: 计划是在下月底之前招聘5名Java工程师。
author: vicch

text: The main problem with Tom is that he has no sense of humor.
translation: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有
author: pig8322

text: For the new year, Liu's company gives every employee a bag of flour.
translation: 过年时，小刘的单位给每位员工发一袋面粉。
author: egg0073

text: I was walking along the crowded street when all at once I heard a shrill cry.
translation: 我在人来人往的街道上走著，突然听见一下尖锐的叫声。
author: CM

text: There's a train station in Japan where the station master is a cat.
translation: 在日本，有站长是猫的车站。
author: Trailsend

text: I lost my job and I have no money. I'm at my wit's end.
translation: 我失业又没钱。真不知该何去何从。
author: CM

text: What places are you planning to visit in your travels? And how? And why?
translation: 你打算去哪些地方旅行？怎么去？为什么？
author: FeuDRenais2

text: By turning the page, we can dismiss the characters in a book without fear of hurting their feelings.
translation: 书页翻动之间，我们可以对书中的人物不予理会而不伤及他们的情感。
author: eastasiastudent

text: I lost my receipt and had to call customer service at both IKEA and the bank.
translation: 我遗失了收据，不得不给 IKEA 和银行的客服部门打电话。
author: camouat

text: A book I happened to come across at a secondhand bookstore has now become my favorite.
translation: 我在二手书店看到一本书，现在它成为了我最爱的书。
author: atitarev

text: They have both failed to find the most serious problem that has ever faced our planet.
translation: 他们俩都未能找到我们的星球所面临最严重的问题。
author: eastasiastudent

text: If it were not for the computer, how inconvenient our lives would be!
translation: 如果没有电脑的话，我们的生活会是多么的不方便呢！
author: CM

text: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.
translation: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。
author: CK

text: I wouldn't work for Tom again, no matter how much he paid me.
translation: 汤姆不管给我付多少钱，我都不会再为他工作一次。
author: CK

text: Today is the last day to pay tuition fees, and my credit card has no money on it.
translation: 今天是交学费的最后一天，我银行卡里没钱了。
author: eastasiastudent

text: The large crowd roared in approval as Mark Knopfler played the first few bars of "Money for Nothing".
translation: 就像马克·诺弗勒早期演唱的歌曲《金钱无用》一样，绝大多数的人依然高呼赞成“金钱无用论”。
author: patgfisher

text: I thought that we had found the perfect hiding place, but the police found us.
translation: 我以为我们发现了绝妙的藏身之处，但警察找到了我们。
author: CK

text: Not long after I joined the queue, a man approached and asked if I wanted a taxi.
translation: 我排上队不久后，一个男人过来问我要不要出租车。
author: sundown

text: In order to give him a surprise on his birthday, I prepared a fantastic cake.
translation: 为了给他生日惊喜，我准备了一个非常棒的蛋糕。
author: eastasiastudent

text: This may be a silly question, but which is stronger - a tiger or a lion?
translation: 这可能是个蠢问题，但是一头老虎和一头狮子哪个更厉害？
author: fcbond

text: Most letters from his wife were read to him by the nurse in the hospital.
translation: 他住院时，大部分太太给他写的信由护士读给他听。
author: eastasiastudent

text: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?
translation: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？
author: xorgy

text: The staff in this shop are really friendly; no wonder they've got so many customers.
translation: 这家商店人员的态度特好，怪不得顾客也好多。
author: sundown

text: A little knowledge of Spanish will go a long way toward making your trip to Mexico enjoyable.
translation: 懂一点西班牙语的话，你去墨西哥一定会玩得更愉快。
author: CK

text: Which translation of this book do you think is better, the French one or the English one?
translation: 你觉得这本书的哪个译本比较好？法语的还是英语的？
author: CK

text: When we look back at our youth, there seems to be an indescribable pain.
translation: 当我们回眸青春，仿佛有一种说不出的痛。
author: weihaiping

text: In this album all the sounds that you hear are really elaborate computer voices.
translation: 在这张专辑里，所有你听到的声音都是用电脑精密制作出的声音。
author: Zifre

text: In the hands of a skilled designer, any two colors can go well together.
translation: 无论是多么不协和的两种颜色，在技术高超的设计师手里，也能化成悦目的配搭。
author: FlamingTofu

text: I got lost, and to make it even worse, it then began to rain.
translation: 我迷了路，而且更糟的是天开始下雨了。
author: Objectivesea

text: I'm going to sit on the bench over there next to the street lamp.
translation: 我会在那盏街灯旁边的长凳上坐下来。
author: papabear

text: The population of London is much greater than that of any other British city.
translation: 伦敦的人口远远多于其他英国城市的人口。
author: CK

text: It makes no difference to me whether Fred came to the party or not.
translation: Fred来不来聚会对我来说没分别。
author: fucongcong

text: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.
translation: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。
author: CS

text: The teacher of the kindergarten told the pupils to respect, and cherish each other.
translation: 幼儿园的老师告诉小朋友们要互敬互爱。
author: trieuho

text: The first person who ate crab must also have tried to eat a spider.
translation: 第一个吃螃蟹的人一定也吃过蜘蛛。
author: voxbubnya

text: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
translation: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。
author: CM

text: Some of the bluest water in the world is found in Crater Lake.
translation: 一些世界上最蓝的水在火山湖。
author: kebukebu

text: The difference between Earth and the other planets is that Earth has water.
translation: 地球跟其它星球不同是因为它有水。
author: CM

text: At the end of April, the water of the Yellow River had darkened.
translation: 四月底，黄河的水发黑了。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Michael, this is the restaurant where your father and I had our first date.
translation: 麦可，这家餐厅就是你爸爸和我第一次约会的地方。
author: CN

text: I've seen an article on the Tatoeba blog about a new version coming soon. Have you read it?
translation: 我在Tatoeba的博客上看到一篇文章，提到很快就会出一个新的版本，你们看到了吗？
author: sysko

text: The train was so crowded that we were obliged to stand all the way to Osaka.
translation: 火车很挤迫，一直驶到了大阪我们都要站著。
author: CM

text: You should use words to make sentences, rather than try to learn them with rote memorisation.
translation: 你应该宁可用词汇来造句，也不要试着死记硬背。
author: aestate

text: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.
translation: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。
author: CK

text: He said that if he knew her address, he would write to her.
translation: 他说如果他知道她的地址，他会写信给她。
author: CK

text: I caught a glimpse of Mt. Fuji from the window of the train.
translation: 我从火车车窗瞥见了富士山。
author: bajama

text: It's probably going to take you about three hours to read this book.
translation: 你大概会需要三小时读这本书。
author: CK

text: For the whole day yesterday I was learning English words off by heart.
translation: 我昨天一天都在背英语单词。
author: sharris123

text: The junction box allows you to store the camera's pigtail inside of it.
translation: 接线盒可以用来存放摄影机的尾线。
author: illiterate

text: In the previous meeting, we already discussed the organizational problem within our company.
translation: 在上次会议中我们已经讨论了我们集团的组织问题。
author: Aphima

text: This is probably my very last world trip. After this one, I'm done.
translation: 这大概是我最后一次环球旅行，在此之后，我就不再环游世界了。
author: LoverofEnglish

text: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.
translation: 我数著星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。
author: khungla

text: I just remembered that I was supposed to buy a loaf of bread.
translation: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。
author: CK

text: I thought that the metro was free, so I went without a ticket.
translation: 我以为地铁是免费的，所以我没买票就去了。
author: DJ_Saidez

text: I didn't arrive in Harbin until very late, and the queue for taxis was already extremely long.
translation: 我很晚才到了哈尔滨，等出租汽车的队伍已经长极了。
author: eastasiastudent

text: In China, southern people eat rice as staple food; northern people eat wheaten food as staple food.
translation: 在中国，南方人以米饭为主食，北方人以面食为主食。
author: DJ_Saidez

text: I have the power of invisibility, but it only works when I’m wearing a freshly washed shirt.
translation: 我有隐身之能，不过仅限于我穿一件刚洗过的上衣的时候。
author: tsp_2

text: The exam that every student failed is harder than the exam that every student passed.
translation: 所有学生都挂科的考试比所有学生都通过的考试要难。
author: gleki

text: The woman has suffered from a collapse, because she ate meat from a water buffalo.
translation: 女人食用水牛肉导致晕厥。
author: Zurich899

text: She is married to an English teacher, so she can take lessons free of charge.
translation: 她的老公是英文老师，所以她能免费上英文课。
author: Luornu

text: Even though I studied English for 6 years in school, I'm not good at speaking it.
translation: 尽管我在学校学了6年英语，我还是说不好。
author: Scott

text: Sami has to go to his chemistry class and he will see you in Arabic.
translation: 萨米得去上他的化学课，他会用阿拉伯语和你会面。
author: OsoHombre

text: He has been devoted to the study of atomic energy ever since he graduated from the university.
translation: 从他大学毕业后，他就一直致力于原子能的研究。
author: papabear

text: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.
translation: 惧怕爱就是惧怕生活，那些惧怕生活的人已经有四分之三部分死了。
author: Scott

text: Tom is the head of the company in name only. His son makes all the important decisions.
translation: 汤姆名义上市公司的领导。他儿子做所有重大决策。
author: DostKaplan

text: Whether the characters in a book are real or completely imaginary, they can become your friends and companions.
translation: 无论书中的人物是真实的还是完全假想的，他们能成为你的伙伴和朋友。
author: eastasiastudent

text: One of the reasons that we love nature is that, unlike ourselves, nature is not envious or deceitful.
translation: 我们之所以爱自然——其原由之一，至少是由于它不像我们人那样既嫉妒又欺骗。
author: garborg

text: As I've already mentioned before, after a rigorous investigation, we have found nothing wrong with our company's management.
translation: 正如我之前提到的，经过严格的调查后，我们发现公司的管理层没有任何问题。
author: andresangelini

text: If he had been a little more careful, the accident would have been avoided.
translation: 如果他当时再小心一点点，事故就不会发生了。
author: CK

text: The remark you made at the party about Lisa's weight was totally uncalled for.
translation: 你在聚会中针对Lisa体重作出的评论是完全不适当的。
author: darinmex

text: I'm not a poet; I couldn't write a single line to depict its beauty.
translation: 我不是诗人，无法用一行文字描绘它的美丽。
author: eastasiastudent

text: If a sick person folds one thousand paper cranes, her wish will come true.
translation: 如果一个病人折一千只纸鹤，她的愿望就会成真。
author: Zifre

text: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
translation: 鲨鱼的皮比鲔鱼的皮粗糙多了。
author: CK

text: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
translation: 他的妻子在医院里因为她在一场车祸中受伤了。
author: CK

text: At the time there were no native English speakers teaching in any public school.
translation: 当时没有任何以英语为母语的人在公立学校任教。
author: fcbond

text: The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.
translation: 老师和她爱人带着参加婚礼的人来到一个公园。
author: aeriph

text: The post office is closed on Christmas day and mail will not be delivered.
translation: 圣诞节当天邮局休息，邮件将不予投递。
author: Hybrid

text: Edinburgh already offers a busy and traditional city experience, with many historic buildings and tourist attractions.
translation: 爱丁堡已经供应一个繁忙而传统的城市，有许多历史性的建筑物和名胜。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Nothing in the world is worth having or worth doing unless it means effort, pain, difficulty.
translation: 世间没有一种具有真正价值的东西，可以不 经过艰苦辛勤的劳动而能够得到的。
author: Objectivesea

text: Carlos's work as a customer service representative requires him to be friendly and helpful to customers.
translation: 卡洛斯的客服代表工作要求他对客户友好且乐于帮助客户。
author: Amastan

text: In the London underground there is a warning to "mind the gap" when boarding the train.
translation: 在伦敦地铁，上车时会有「注意间隙」提醒。
author: Shiawase

text: Tom's mother is a nurse at the hospital that's across the street from where Mary lives.
translation: 汤姆的妈妈是一名护士，她所在的医院就在玛丽住的那条街的对面。
author: CK

text: Had he known what was about to happen, he would have changed his plan.
translation: 要是他知道会发生什么，他就会改变计划。
author: Dejo

text: Alice, not knowing where to find the book, asked her mother where it was.
translation: Alice 不知道书本放了在哪里，于是便去问母亲。
author: CN

text: Don't worry! Even if I drink, it doesn't have an effect on my driving.
translation: 别担心！即使我喝酒了，它对我的驾驶没有影响。
author: Scott

text: He came back not because he was homesick, but because he was running short of money.
translation: 他不是因为想家，而是因为没钱才回来的。
author: CK

text: As it is written in simple English, this book is easy to read.
translation: 由于是用简单的英语所写的，这本书很容易阅读。
author: omiros

text: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
translation: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。
author: CK

text: Eighty percent of all information on computers around the world is in English.
translation: 全世界百分之八十电脑上的资讯都是用英语写的。
author: CK

text: He has an interesting job, for which he has to work a lot.
translation: 他有个很有意思但很费功夫的工作。
author: Liface

text: As is often the case, Mike was late for the meeting this afternoon.
translation: 麦克今天下午的会议迟到了，这是常有的事。
author: CN

text: Either as a waiter at a restaurant or a bartender, both are OK.
translation: 做餐馆服务员啊、酒吧招待员啊，都可以。
author: minshirui

text: He sat down and read while his wife was cooking by the fire.
translation: 他妻子在灶旁做饭，而他在坐着读书。
author: _undertoad

text: The police now believe that Tom had something to do with Mary's disappearance.
translation: 警方现在认为汤姆和玛丽的失踪有干系。
author: CK

text: He has written a book, however, he has no money to publish it.
translation: 他写了一本书，但是没有钱出版。
author: antonb

text: It's better for me to sit on the train than to be crushed.
translation: 我坐在火车上总还是比掉到火车底下要好。
author: Josephlingo

text: Many foreign tourists consider Ximending one of the must-visit spots in Taipei.
translation: 许多外国观光客都把西门町列为台北必访景点之一。
author: LeviHighway

text: If you leave now, I'm sure you'll be caught in a traffic jam.
translation: 你现在出门的话，肯定会堵车的。
author: CK

text: I can't calculate the final cost without first discussing it with our contractors.
translation: 不先与我们的承包商讨论的话我无法计算出最后的费用。
author: Cindrogriza

text: I'll eat almost anything, but I'm very fickle when it comes to cheese.
translation: 我是什么都吃的那种人，但是吃起司却很讲心情。
author: darinmex

text: A lawyer is a person who prevents someone else from getting your money.
translation: 律师是防止别人拿你的钱的人。
author: karloelkebekio

text: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.
translation: 若没有将衣服折起来或是挂在衣架上，会起皱纹。
author: WestofEden

text: It is easier to study when you are sitting in a comfortable chair.
translation: 当你坐在一把舒适的椅子上的时候，更容易学习。
author: trieuho

text: I am really extremely angry, so I plan to smash things to vent my anger.
translation: 我实在气得不得了，所以打算砸东西发泄。
author: weihaiping

text: It seems that the purpose of his study abroad was to improve his ability to speak English.
translation: 看来他出国学习的目的是要提高他说英语的能力。
author: carlosalberto

text: There are so many mistakes in this book that the teacher has dubbed it "The Drunkard's Edition".
translation: 这本书里错误多得以至于老师把它叫作“醉鬼版”。
author: FeuDRenais

text: The lack of gender in English is not due to the English having a more egalitarian culture.
translation: 英文中没有阴阳性并不是因为英国人的文化偏向平等。
author: mailohilohi

text: I could eat some beef noodle soup, or some reheated rice with soybean paste like that, no problem.
translation: 我可以不慌不忙吃牛奶面包鸡蛋，或者泡饭酱菜。
author: peterius

text: When I was in elementary school, my mother always fetched me from school.
translation: 我读小学的时候，我母亲常常来接我。
author: omfgitsasalmon

text: I am a selfish person, but I became very selfless after meeting you.
translation: 我是个很自私的人，但是遇到你之后变得特别地无私。
author: Aphima

text: The doctor told Mr Smith to give up smoking if he wanted to live long.
translation: 医生告诉史密斯先生他要长寿的话就得戒烟。
author: frpzzd

text: It took John only one day to make friends with his classmates at the school.
translation: 约翰只上了一天的学，就和班上的同学都成了朋友。
author: CN

text: Obviously, this cannot be the work of one person. This is why Tatoeba is collaborative.
translation: 很明显，这不可能是一个人的工作。这就是为什么Tatoeba是一个合作项目。
author: jakov

text: Memorising the cards in a deck in order is certainly a difficult task, but manageable.
translation: 把一叠扑克牌的排列次序背熟，虽然绝不是一件易事，却也不是没有可能的。
author: LittleBoy

text: I've got nothing to do, so I'm writing some sentences for other people to learn.
translation: 我没事写点句子让他人学习。
author: 21violins

text: Since I installed solar panels on my house, my energy bill has been cut in half.
translation: 自从我在我的房子上装了太阳能电池板，我的电费单就减半了。
author: darinmex

text: We raced against our deskmate to see who could memorize the text faster, and I lost.
translation: 我们和同桌比赛看谁背书快，结果我输了。
author: LeviHighway

text: In all of the gardens in my city it is illegal to trample the flower beds.
translation: 在我的城市的所有花园里，践踏花坛是违法的。
author: odiernod

text: My brother was supposed to pick me up at the station, but I couldn't find him.
translation: 我的弟弟应该会来车站接我的，但是我却找不到他。
author: carlosalberto

text: I would love to write hundreds of sentences on Tatoeba, but I've got things to do.
translation: 我真想在 Tatoeba 写很多很多的句子，不过我有别的事要做。
author: lugal

text: Europe, with its four distinct seasons, is the most suitable environment for the human race to live in.
translation: 欧洲四季分明，是最适合人类居住的地区。
author: snowxvi

text: During that era, the fate of doctors was in the hands of people who did not understand medicine.
translation: 那个时代，医生的命运掌握在不懂医术的人的手里。
author: sharris123

text: The billiard ball bounced off of three different sides of the table before landing in a side pocket.
translation: 那颗撞球在桌面的三个边框上各回弹了一下，最后落入一个边袋。
author: frpzzd

text: Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.
translation: 父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。
author: darinmex

text: A free-trade agreement between Europe and the United States is currently under negotiation.
translation: 欧洲和美国的一份自由贸易协定正在商议中。
author: _undertoad

text: The length of a marriage is inversely proportional to the cost of the wedding.
translation: 婚姻的长度与婚宴的花费负相关。
author: ddnktr

text: Lonely people tend to be afraid of meeting others, which ensures they will always be lonely.
translation: 孤独的人会孤独，是因为他畏惧他人。
author: Trailsend

text: Of course, another explanation of this situation is that Chinese is harder to learn than English.
translation: 当然，对这个情况的另一个解释是中文比英文难学。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Miss Wang has a trace of obstinacy in her, but she is still a good student.
translation: 王小姐有一点固执，但是她还算是一个好学生。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Due to the large amounts of snow over the last few days, school has been cancelled.
translation: 由于这几天下了很多雪，因此学校停课了。
author: sharris123

text: My appointment at the hospital completely slipped my mind. Why didn't you remind me?
translation: 我在医院的任期完全记得，为什么你没有想起我。
author: patgfisher

text: It was last Friday that I ate dinner with my girlfriend in a restaurant.
translation: 我是上个星期五跟我女朋友在饭馆吃饭的。
author: eastasiastudent

text: It was with my girlfriend that I ate dinner in a restaurant last Friday.
translation: 我上个星期五是跟我女朋友在饭馆吃饭的。
author: eastasiastudent

text: It was in a restaurant that I ate dinner last Friday with my girlfriend.
translation: 我上个星期五跟我女朋友是在饭馆吃饭的。
author: eastasiastudent

text: I am in Lyon, but maybe I'll go to Paris for hunting a job.
translation: 我在里昂，不过没准去巴黎找工作。
author: fenfang557

text: Tom has to do better on the next test or he'll fail my class.
translation: 汤姆在下次考试需要考好，或者他将失败我的课。
author: CK

text: When he asked who had broken the window, all the boys put on an air of innocence.
translation: 当他问道是谁打碎了玻璃时，所有的男孩子们都装作一副无辜的样子。
author: Zifre

text: From that day forth he merely tasted his food, and only just moistened his lips with drink.
translation: 从那时开始他就只是尝一尝他的食物，也仅仅只是用饮料润湿了嘴唇而已。
author: Hybrid

text: If confidence, determination and courage are together in one place, there is nothing that cannot be done.
translation: 信心、毅力、勇气三者具备，则天下没有做不成的事。
author: sharris123

text: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
translation: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
author: CK

text: His bag is right here, so he cannot have gone to school yet.
translation: 他的包就在这儿，所以他不可能已经去了学校。
author: CM

text: On the table, there was a plate with three fried eggs on it.
translation: 桌子上放著一个盘子，上面放著三颗煎蛋。
author: CK

text: Those two communicate a lot with each other at work, often rubbing shoulders.
translation: 他们俩工作上联系多，经常打交道。
author: Aphima

text: The roads are slippery on a rainy day. Be careful not to fall.
translation: 雨天路滑，小心摔跤。
author: Aphima

text: David decided to sneak into the kitchen and find something delicious to eat.
translation: 大卫决定偷偷溜进厨房，找点好吃的吃。
author: Amastan

text: The city government held a large conference aimed at promoting cross-departmental cooperation.
translation: 市政府举行了一次大型公会，旨在促进跨部门合作。
author: LeviHighway

text: It is very dangerous to jump aboard the train when it is moving.
translation: 跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。
author: Mouseneb

text: When Tom woke up, he found Mary reading a book at the desk.
translation: 汤姆醒来的时候看到玛丽在书桌前看一本书。
author: CK

text: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
translation: 我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。
author: darinmex

text: The ages of the two children put together was equivalent to that of their father.
translation: 两个孩子的年龄加起来和他们的父亲相当。
author: CK

text: The Pacific Ocean alone covers an area larger than that of all continents put together.
translation: 仅太平洋的面积就比所有的大陆的总和面积还要大。
author: eastasiastudent

text: Opera in English is, in the main, just about as sensible as baseball in Italian.
translation: 以英语唱的歌剧，大致上和以意大利语玩的棒球般过得去。
author: trieuho

text: While he was waiting for the train, he listened to music and sent text messages.
translation: 他等火车的时候，一会儿听音乐，一会儿发短信。
author: Mouseneb

text: When travelling, I always go to the airport in Nanjing, I've never been to Shanghai.
translation: 我出去玩都是在南京坐飞机，没去过上海。
author: humorous9830

text: He didn't not come because he was sick, but because his wife wouldn't let him.
translation: 他没来不是因为生病，而是因为老婆不让。
author: araneo

text: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
translation: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。
author: garborg

text: I asked twenty people to my party but not all of them came.
translation: 我邀请了二十人参加我们的聚会，但不是所有人都来。
author: CK
